title: Pressure Inez
why: Take 2 has the most life: she mistakes him for the Bureau and runs to the loan, the safe wrong explanation. Its tube threat and her slip "us" were weak, so the cause now comes from take 3. Holds to [5a29be8544e336060f678471] and [c407d23e4f6647fe2f4315a1]: fear, resentment, can identify the Fixer. Conflict for Aster, not resolved here: [e1dd761142af169bfd1cc0d3] says his café stop before shift is to see her; the scene sheet says they are never together unless she calls. The scene mentions neither.
changes: Replaced the slip "us" and the invented tube and "tonight" deadline. She breaks off on "if I can't", and he finishes her sentence with the letter, so she never names what they are.
Lifted the unsigned-letter exchange from take 3 as the cause of the yes: her last hope, no signature, is shut just before she gives in.
Merged her yes and her bite into one line. "Didn't pay" lands because he came with no money, and it puts her memory of his face on the page.
Cut his "One minute at your side" answer and put the minute after the stamp. His last line now goes short and concedes she will remember him.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: If you're the Bureau, my card's stamped, here, and I've got tables.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Put that away. You'll call Okafor off his door when I telephone.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Who? It's the loan, it's only the loan, and if I can't—

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Then a letter about you and Okafor goes across the square.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: From who, you won't sign it, nobody reads a letter with no—

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: The Office stamps unsigned letters too. We only want him a minute.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: One call, no letter. I never forget a face that didn't pay.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: No, you won't. Table two is waving.

learned: Afraid, resentful, knows the Fixer's face
